issues.what: The planned climb to the bare rock happens in ch1, then ch3 says she has never seen it and climbs again (to 4,700 m and back in about an hour, at night), then ch5 climbs a third time 'as if new', remembering it 'from childhood photos'
issues.quote: You have not seen it. You build a glacier and you have not seen the mother.

issues.what: Stanzin is Konchok's youngest (ch1-3), but ch2 says his father is one of the young men, and ch5 introduces Jigmet as 'Konchok's son' as if new and hands him Stanzin's notebook while Stanzin reads
issues.quote: The boy glanced at his father, one of the young men.

issues.what: The 1968 slip on the glacier is told three ways: Skarma's father slipped and was carried (ch3); father's sprain iced by her mother (ch4); Nawang slipped and hurt his knee (ch5)
issues.quote: Here I slipped. 1968. Your father laughed, then cried because my knee swelled.

issues.what: Dates are impossible for the cast: a grandfather of a 29-year-old in 2039 cutting ice in 1960 with a son already a boy; the brief's 'precise about 1960' is pasted into the narration
issues.quote: Precise about 1960. Today kept sliding off him like water off oiled cloth.

issues.what: Leaked glitch with a stray Chinese character in the prose
issues.quote: Nawang慢. No, Nawang slow, stopping to breathe

issues.what: Stanzin reads 'three nights of paired readings' the morning after the gully's first night
issues.quote: Three nights of paired readings.

issues.what: The diesel-shop man is called Tsering, the same name as Skarma's father
issues.quote: Tsering, who owned the diesel shop.

issues.what: Grandfather is Memey, then Memay (ch3), then Baba ley (ch4); Stanzin calls Skarma 'Apa ley' (father) instead of Achey
issues.quote: Baba ley, you are right.

issues.what: Stanzin reports eleven litres that morning, but ch2's morning reading was four; the 3 a.m. text reports a 'morning' reading that has not been taken yet
issues.quote: Eleven litres in morning. Now seven.

issues.what: Repeats: the split-pipe 'white plume and shame' memory told again word for word, the lammergeier 'wings flat' image from ch1, and three separate stories of the father crying as a boy
issues.quote: the crack Skarma still dreamed about, white plume and shame

issues.what: Typo and brief phrasing: 'meltwaterMilky'; 'Her city design failing in Ladakh in real time' echoes the planned-moment text
issues.quote: blue crevasses, meltwaterMilky in summer

issues.what: Chapter 4 is titled 'Ten to Three', but the ten-to-three deal is made in ch3 and ch4 has no spraying; ch5 'The Shaded Gully' repeats ch4's subject
issues.quote: Chapter 4: Ten to Three

fix: Ch1: rewrite the brief-pasted lines and move Nawang's years to 1985/1990 so they fit his age. Ch2: make Stanzin Konchok's boy and rename 'Stanzin's wall'. Ch3: the night climb goes to the shoulder to watch the cold come down, not a first visit to the rock; fix Memey, the flow numbers, the 3 a.m. text and the typo. Ch4: rename the diesel-shop man, fix the forms of address. Ch5: Jigmet becomes Konchok's elder son, readings cover one night, the slip story matches ch3/ch4, the third climb is called a return, remove the glitch and the repeats. Retitle ch3-5.
praise: The science of ice is tactile and right: cold air pooling in the hollow, the double padlock and a ten-year-old's ruler make the water dispute concrete and neighbourly, not villainous.

issues.what: The map reveal is staged again as if new: 'Show me the empty space', the white LOW CONFIDENCE hole, 'It is not empty', and Wilmer reads the same 0.8/0.75/0.12 table he found in ch2
issues.quote: Miraflores zero point eight. San Isidro zero point seven five. Villa Maria zero point one two.

issues.what: Timeline break: the full test is 26 days away (ch3/ch4) and ch1 says thirty, but ch4 holds it 'on the tenth night' after nine nights of data
issues.quote: On the tenth night the first full test arrived.

issues.what: The spray schedule changes: 2 to 5 a.m. over three nights in ch2, then 22:00 in ch3 and ten o'clock in ch4
issues.quote: Towers spray from two to five in the morning when the marine layer is thickest.

issues.what: Says he has not called her Mama since the doctorate, though he says 'Mama' in every chapter
issues.quote: He had not called her that since before the doctorate.

issues.what: Wrong science: a liter is about 20,000 drizzle-net drops, not four hundred
issues.quote: One liter was about four hundred drops from this seam

issues.what: Objects drift: the chipped tin cup with the moon-shaped dent becomes a white enamel cup; the small grey car becomes a white rental, then a white university car
issues.quote: A chipped enamel cup, white with a blue rim.

issues.what: 'This is how a net fills a tank' (the planned moment) is told a second and third time (ch3, ch4); 'Tired eyes. Salt still on his cuff' repeats ch2
issues.quote: Dawn was still hours off, but this was how a net filled a tank.

issues.what: Yolanda says he kept it quiet 'at the committee', but he has never been to one; morning fog droplets still on his fleece at four in the afternoon
issues.quote: did not say it aloud at the committee

issues.what: The grid-resolution explanation from ch3 is given again; the Metropolitano does not run to Villa María; 'stopped writing' should be 'stopped answering'
issues.quote: the reason she had stopped writing

issues.what: Titles: ch1 'Álvaro Returns' (spelled Alvaro in the text) and ch4 'Sensor on Net Three' (the sensor goes up in ch3) do not fit; ch2 'The Miraflores Lab' does not tell apart two lab chapters. Text also drops the accents (Senora, Dona, Villa Maria)
issues.quote: Chapter 4: Sensor on Net Three

fix: Ch2: two nights, sprays from ten; fix the committee line and the fleece droplets. Ch3: turn the repeated map reveal into a new one (the lidar layer over the hole) with a new number for Wilmer; fix the tin cup, the grey car, the drops-per-liter figure and the repeated lines. Ch4: remove the doctorate 'Mama' line, move the test to night 26 with about 25 nights of data, fix the car and the repeats. Retitle ch1, ch2 and ch4.
praise: Fog nets drawn with real care (the tin cup, the chalk marks, Dona Teo's buckets) and a hard, fair ending: the redesigned second test pays the hill in liters, not in forgiveness.
